spans.s: 1. दुह् cl. 1. P. दोहति, to pain, Dhātup.
a daughter (the milker or drawing milk from her mother.)

etym.s: [cf. Zd. dughdar, Gk. θυγάτηρ, Goth. dauhtar, Lith. duktė́, Slav. dushti]

spans.s: दुहि˚ता-मातृ f. du. daughter and mother, Kathās. xcviii, 54.
दुहि˚तुः-पति m. a daughter's husband, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 24, Kāś.
दुहि˚तृ-त्व n. the condition of a daughter, MBh.; Pur.
दुहितृ—मत् mfn. having a daughter, GS.
